tasks.title: Daily Life
tasks.instruction: Read an excerpt from a syllabus.

layout.body:
This course explores classical mechanics, thermodynamics, and electromagnetism through lectures, labs, and problem-solving sessions.
Students will develop analytical skills and apply mathematical models to physical systems. Weekly assignments, lab reports, and exams assess understanding.
Prerequisites include calculus.
Attendance and participation are essential for success.

questions.stem: What is the most likely subject of the course?
questions.analysis: ​​​What is the most likely subject of the course? 原文依据：This course explores classical mechanics, thermodynamics, and electromagnetism. 翻译：本课程涵盖经典力学、热力学与电磁学内容。 选项分析： (A) Biology 生物学 → 错误（原文无任何生物相关内容） (B) Calculus 微积分 → 错误（微积分是课程先修要求，并非课程科目） (C) Physics 物理学 → 正确（力学、热力学、电磁学均为物理核心内容） (D) Sociology 社会学 → 错误（和文本自然科学内容完全无关）

questions.stem: What is NOT mentioned as an assessment method?
questions.analysis: What is NOT mentioned as an assessment method? 原文依据：Weekly assignments, lab reports, and exams assess understanding. 翻译：每周作业、实验报告和考试用于考核学习掌握情况。 选项分析： (A) Weekly exercises 每周练习 → 对应原文 Weekly assignments，原文提及，正确 (B) Lab reports 实验报告 → 原文直接提及，正确 (C) Tests 测验 / 考试 → 对应原文 exams，原文提及，正确 (D) Essays 短文 / 论文 → 原文未出现，为未提及内容，符合题意
